pages.title: Bramatherium
pages.text: Bramatherium ($(o)Bramatherium perimense$()) is an extinct giraffid that lived from India to the eastern Mediterranean during the Late Miocene, named after Perim Island off western India.$(br2)It was a close relative of $(o)Sivatherium$(), with a heavily built, okapi-like body.$(br2)Its skull carried a striking crown of four ossicones radiating outwards, and wear on its teeth suggests it lived in woodlands and wetlands.
